title: Divar
summary: Campaign key visuals and an AI mascot, brought together in one distinctive visual world.
challenge: Give different campaigns a recognisable shared language, while making AI features feel approachable.
role: Key visual design, art direction and AI mascot identity.
deliverables: Campaign imagery, a character system and a family of category assets for digital touchpoints.
credits: Design by Ali Komeili. Presentation imagery recreated from the original project references.

blocks.title: One world. Different stories.
blocks.text: A vivid red stage connects the work. Ivory objects and warm yellow accents give each campaign its own focus: promoting a listing, finding a car or discovering something new. The composition changes with the message; the visual language stays familiar.

blocks.alt: Divar AI character guiding listing cards through a sculptural red campaign world

alts: AI character helping a listing rise beside a red ladder
Red compact car hovering above a yellow turntable

blocks.title: A helpful presence.
blocks.text: The mascot gives AI a visible personality. A compact body, articulated hands and an amber display form a simple, repeatable character. Gestures and screen expressions introduce different functions without changing its identity.

blocks.alt: Ivory cube AI mascot holding a yellow pencil on a warm white background
Three expressions of the same AI character: promotion, conversation and discovery

blocks.title: From a visual to an experience.
blocks.text: The same language moves from a campaign scene to the smaller assets around a digital experience. The character brings a human point of connection, while a restrained family of category objects makes the wider marketplace feel coherent.

blocks.alt: A person using a phone in a yellow chair, accompanied by Divar’s AI character
Eight coordinated marketplace category illustrations on a warm white background
